Remember to revert EXPO_PUBLIC_TRUSTED_CIRCLE_RECIPIENT back to false in frontend/.env after this dev/preview verification, as stated in the problem description (not reverted by this testing agent - leaving that to main agent per instructions).
critical_code_review_comments: trusted-circle.tsx: inviteFor() matches sentInvites by contact_phone only - if an owner re-invites the same phone after a prior revoke/decline, the UI will show the OLD invite's terminal status (revoked/declined) indefinitely instead of offering a fresh Invite link, because inviteFor() returns the first match rather than the most recent. Confirmed this behavior while testing (a previously-revoked test invite blocked the panel from appearing again for the same phone number). This is a minor UX edge case, not a security issue - not in explicit scope of this pass but worth a follow-up ticket for 'allow re-invite after revoke/decline'.
No regressions found in the local device-only circle (add/remove/notify-toggle/call) or app navigation during this pass.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up via normal flow: 2 trusted_circle invites between Account A (owner) and Account B (recipient) - one via backend pytest (phone 9000000002, accepted then revoked), one via UI test (phone 9000000002, accepted then revoked via UI tap). No residual pending invites left; both ended in 'revoked' terminal state which is safe/expected test residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_TRUSTED_CIRCLE_RECIPIENT=true was required in frontend/.env for this feature to render; confirm with main agent whether it has been reverted to false post-test as planned. Local device contact list (src/women/api.ts getCircle/saveCircle) does NOT persist across separate browser-automation tool invocations (resets each session) - this is expected device-local storage behavior, not a bug; just requires adding a fresh contact within the same script when chaining multi-step UI tests.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found in the NEW UI being tested this pass. One minor pre-existing UX limitation noted in code review above (inviteFor() first-match-wins on repeat invites to same phone after revoke/decline).
